calls.claim: Give me LSU minus 10. I mean, I've been standing on a mountaintop yelling about Clemson for a while now. I don't think this program is in a good spot. You can't tell me LSU isn't far more talented than this Clemson team is. It's Baton Rouge. It's the first game of the Kiffin era. LSU minus 10.
calls.subject: LSU
calls.reasoning: He is laying LSU because Clemson’s QB/OL/defense attrition has the program in a bad spot and because he thinks LSU is clearly more talented in Kiffin’s Baton Rouge opener.
